ref_extractions.title: Inter-database validation of a deep learning approach for automatic sleep scoring
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is the original publication associated with the HMC dataset creation. It explicitly uses the HMC dataset as one of six public sleep staging databases for inter-database validation. It defines a 5-class sleep staging classification task (wakefulness, N1, N2, N3, R) with 30-second epochs. The paper evaluates CNN-LSTM architectures and reports kappa scores for both local (0.80) and external (0.54-0.62) validation scenarios.
ref_extractions.epoch_params: 30-second epochs, five-class AASM sleep staging, multiple EEG/EOG/EMG channels
ref_extractions.label_mapping: wakefulness, N1, N2, N3, R (AASM 2.4 guidelines)
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Explicitly describes HMC dataset collection and use among six databases for inter-database validation of automatic sleep scoring with 30s epochs into five stages. Reports kappa performance metrics for local and external validation scenarios.
